scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/server && npm run lint -w apps/web
